company.name: Earli
company.shortDescription: Earli develops genetic constructs for early cancer detection and targeted therapy.
company.description: Earli is a developer of cancer treatment devices designed to search for natural biomarkers. The company's mission is to make cancer a benign experience. Cancers are detected early when they are homogeneous; and then located early, so they can be treated when the chances of survival are multiple times higher. Rather than rely on biomarkers that cancer may - or often may not - naturally provide, Earli's technology forces cancer cells to make a synthetic, non-human biomarker using a novel gene therapy approach called Synthetic Biopsy. The early cancer is then visible in a PET scanner. The same platform is also usable for therapeutics.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

productsAndServices.description: A technology that programs genetic constructs to activate only in cancer cells, causing them to produce detectable synthetic biomarkers for early cancer detection and localization.
productsAndServices.name: Synthetic Biopsy

productsAndServices.description: A platform that detects cancer by answering if cells are cancerous and then produces encoded proteins to aid in detection or therapy.

aiResearchSummary.text: Earli is researching synthetic cancer-specific promoters and methods for engineering these genetic elements, as described in 'Synthetic cancer-specific promoters.' They are also developing nucleic acids with genetic elements for detecting diseased cells, according to 'Methods and compositions for synthetic biomarkers.' Additionally, they are working on engineered polypeptides with surface-expressible activatable epitopes for localization and treatment, as detailed in 'Methods using surface-expressable activatable epitopes.' These efforts focus on early cancer detection and targeted therapy.
